lines: Na keh saaqi, bahaar aane ke din hain
couplets.en: Do not tell me, cupbearer, that spring is near.

lines: Jigar ke daagh chhil jaane ke din hain
couplets.en: These are the days when old wounds open again.

lines: Ada seekho, ada aane ke din hain
couplets.en: Learn a little grace, for this is when it comes.

lines: Abhi to door sharmaane ke din hain
couplets.en: The days of blushing are still far off.
My hands reach for my collar.

lines: Chaman mein phool khil jaane ke din hain
couplets.en: It is the season for flowers to open in the garden.

lines: Na keh saaqi, bahaar aane ke din hain
couplets.en: Do not tell me, cupbearer, that spring is near.
What could I tell you of love's secret?

lines: Tumhaare khelne, khaane ke din hain
couplets.en: These are still your days for play and simple pleasures.
The low-hanging clouds seem to be saying something.
It is time to press the grapes for wine.
